value.name: truck idles at curb
value.description: A truck is parked and idling near the house, establishing an active arrival or departure context.
evidence: truck idled at the curb three doors down.

value.name: woman navigates sidewalk with stroller
value.description: A woman pushes a stroller carefully over broken sidewalk bricks, adding to the scene's lived-in street detail.
evidence: A woman with a stroller was negotiating the broken brick of the sidewalk.

value.name: Marcus enters with banker's box
value.description: Marcus arrives behind Asha carrying a banker's box and places it on the table by the window.
evidence: Marcus came in behind her with the banker's box and set it on the round table by the window.

value.name: Marcus checks on Asha
value.description: Marcus asks Asha if she is all right, signaling concern beyond the immediate work at hand.

value.name: Asha deflects concern with work
value.description: Asha answers that she is working, avoiding Marcus's personal question.

value.name: Marcus presses for honest answer
value.description: Marcus insists that he was asking about her well-being, not her workload.

value.name: Asha reasserts work priorities
value.description: Asha softens but redirects the conversation to drafting legal documents for Mr. Halloran by five.
evidence: "I'm working," she said again, more gently. "Let's draft the notice to the buyers' attorney. And the petition to lodge the codicil. I want both on Mr. Halloran's desk by five."

value.name: Marcus reveals he already started notice
value.description: Marcus says he began drafting the notice while in the car, showing initiative and preparedness.
evidence: "Already started the notice in the car."

value.name: Asha acknowledges Marcus's initiative
value.description: Asha responds with dry approval, implying that Marcus's foresight is typical of him.

value.name: Asha and Marcus work on probate documents
value.description: They settle into focused legal work, with Marcus typing and Asha dictating the petition in formal probate language.
evidence: The petition to lodge took shape on his screen in the careful, almost liturgical language of probate, language whose function was to flatten extraordinary domestic events into procedural inevitabilities.

value.name: Asha notices house is only partly heated
value.description: Asha realizes Lucia has been heating only certain rooms, revealing something about Lucia's sleeping arrangements and the house's condition.
evidence: the parlor was cold — Lucia had not been running the heat in the front rooms, Asha noticed, only in the kitchen and the back parlor and the upstairs bedroom where she was sleeping —

value.name: Asha keeps coat on then forgets cold
value.description: Asha initially stays bundled against the cold and then becomes absorbed enough in work to stop noticing it.
evidence: Asha kept her coat on for the first half hour and then forgot about being cold.
